dependencies.purpose: Target OS and privileged system APIs
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Full core maintenance remains available offline
dependencies.exitPath: Core domain models remain isolated from unnecessary Windows-specific types for future portability

dependencies.purpose: Registration, heartbeat, entitlement, release/update coordination and explicit typed non-destructive remote requests
dependencies.dataBoundary: No file contents, browsing history, arbitrary paths, credentials or privileged generic execution
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Local maintenance, monitoring, cleanup and restore remain operational
dependencies.exitPath: App-manager-client is isolated behind one module and can be disabled/replaced

dependencies.dataBoundary: No secrets, private keys, raw scan state, personal file inventory or privileged operation authority
dependencies.exitPath: Portable encrypted export files; provider can be removed without loss of local operation

dependencies.purpose: P10 software update discovery and exact-package interactive upgrade handoff through the official trusted WinGet source
dependencies.dataBoundary: Local installed package identity/version is processed on-device by WinGet; PC Manager does not accept arbitrary download URLs or upload the package inventory to App Manager
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Software update discovery is unavailable offline or when WinGet is absent; all other local PC Manager maintenance remains operational
dependencies.exitPath: Provider is isolated in pc-updater and can be replaced by another trusted local/vendor update provider without changing privileged local authority

releaseGate: Constitution 1.2 local-authority validator plus existing frontend/Rust/Windows CI must pass. Production remains separately authorized.
